Create one landscape 16:9 PNG, at least 1536x1024, containing exactly TWO SEPARATE waist-up character cutouts on a TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Equal left and right halves, one complete character per half.

Plain charcoal unfastened overshirt over stone-grey crewneck. SAME exact face as four lower portraits in reference, no blue fur, hoodie, scarf or accessories. Maintain teen peer appeal for ages 13–15, not an elderly professor. Paws have short furry fingers, never hairless human arms.
LEFT HALF: Warm closed-mouth smile, direct eye contact, upright welcoming pose with both hands open low at waist.
RIGHT HALF: Mouth fully CLOSED. Attentive slight head tilt and eyes on learner. Both forearms and hands relaxed and visible low at waist.

Same exact character and clothing in both halves and as reference. Gaze at learner or toward viewer LEFT, never viewer right. Matte soft high-quality 3D illustration, detailed clean fur, original fictional character. Transparent background is essential. The app adds status icons separately: NO letters, waves, pills, diagrams or labels.
